03 / HOW I APPROACH IT

Make the
complex
understandable.

✳
01

Understand

Listen to the person. Read the signals. Work out what changed and what it affects.

02

Investigate

Trace the dependencies. Test the likely cause. Work across software, hardware and the connection between them.

03

Restore & explain

Check the result. Document what helped. Leave enough clarity for the next person to pick up the trail.

A few ways to explore the work behind the illustration.

Is this a real system dashboard?

+

The room is an original interactive illustration. Its incidents, metrics and console are simulated, so you can explore the ideas without connecting to any real machines.

What kind of work does it represent?

+

Support engineering, datacenter technology, networking, endpoints, identity, hardware and electronics. All of these are part of the same practice.

Can I choose what happens in the room?

+

Yes. Use Choose an incident below the animation. You can pause the story, inspect a device or open the simulated management console.

Can I explore without continuous animation?

+

Yes. Motion quiet stops decorative motion and the automatic room loop. Next step lets you follow the repair at your own pace.
